+from datetime import date, timedelta
+import pytest
+from api.data.edgar import EdgarProvider
+
+TODAY = date(2026, 9, 28)
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('form,items,key,window', [
+    ('NT 10-K', '', 'nt_filings', 120),
+    ('NT 10-Q', '', 'nt_filings', 120),
+    ('8-K', '4.01', 'auditor_changes', 180),
+    ('8-K', '4.02', 'restatements', 180),
+])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('position', ['tomorrow', 'today', 'boundary', 'beyond'])
+def test_window(form, items, key, window, position):
+    age = {'tomorrow': -1, 'today': 0, 'boundary': window, 'beyond': window + 1}[position]
+    filed = (TODAY - timedelta(days=age)).isoformat()
+    result = EdgarProvider._scan_filings({'form': [form], 'filingDate': [filed], 'items': [items]}, TODAY)
+    expected = {'nt_filings': [], 'auditor_changes': [], 'restatements': []}
+    if position in ('today', 'boundary'):
+        expected[key] = [{'form': form, 'date': filed}]
+    assert result == expected
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('bad_date', ['not-a-date', '2026-02-30', None])
+def test_malformed_date(bad_date):
+    result = EdgarProvider._scan_filings({'form': ['NT 10-K', '8-K'], 'filingDate': [bad_date, bad_date], 'items': ['', '4.02']}, TODAY)
+    assert result == {'nt_filings': [], 'auditor_changes': [], 'restatements': []}
+
+def test_restatement_has_priority():
+    filed = TODAY.isoformat()
+    result = EdgarProvider._scan_filings({'form': ['8-K'], 'filingDate': [filed], 'items': ['4.01,4.02']}, TODAY)
+    assert result == {'nt_filings': [], 'auditor_changes': [], 'restatements': [{'form': '8-K', 'date': filed}]}
